From funded deal to your bank

How a commission reaches you

  1. 1

    The deal funds

    Your client accepts an offer and the lender sends the money.

  2. 2

    The commission is paid

    The lender pays the commission on the funded deal to LendTrack.

  3. 3

    Your share is calculated

    30% of the total commission is credited to you and shown in your dashboard.

  4. 4

    You get paid

    Your share goes to your bank by direct deposit under the terms of your partner agreement.

What affects your share

Bigger deals, bigger commissions

Commissions are a percentage of each funded deal, so your share depends on the deal itself.

Deal size

A $150K line of credit generates more commission than a $25K advance.

Funding product

Commission rates differ by product and lender. Your dashboard shows the details for every deal.

Whether it funds

Commissions are only paid on deals that fund. Referrals that don't fund don't earn a commission.

Grow your earnings

How top partners earn more

Put your link everywhere

Your email signature, your website, your invoices and your social profiles. Every place clients already see you.

Ask at natural moments

Annual reviews, tax season, renewals and planning meetings are perfect openings.

Refer the same client again

Growing businesses need capital more than once. There's no limit on repeat referrals.

Use the flyers

A flyer on your front desk or at an event works for you while you're busy.

Think beyond your clients

Friends, family, your gym owner, your mechanic. Every business owner you know counts.

Stay close to your deals

When a referral is waiting on documents, a friendly nudge from you often gets it moving.

FAQ

Questions about getting paid

How much do I earn per funded deal?

30% of the total commission generated. On average, that’s $1,000 to $5,000 per funded deal, depending on deal size and product.

When do I get paid?

After the deal funds and the commission is received. Exact payment timing is set out in the referral partnership agreement you sign when you join.

How do I get paid?

By direct deposit to your bank account. You add your banking details securely in your dashboard.

Is there a limit on how much I can earn?

No. There’s no cap on referrals or commissions.

Are commissions taxable?

Commission income is generally taxable. Talk to your tax professional about how to report it.
